summary: Third attempt at the startup committed-log replay experiment, now with the anchor block removed: the previous rejection reported that declaration identity was not proven by contiguous acquired source, and every anchor pointed into a function body (NewRaft, processLogs) rather than at a declaration, so the request now relies on the registered source ranges alone, as the earlier accepted startup request did. All reused source IDs still match their registered excerpts field-for-field (cfg_restore_option 243-254, cfg_defaults 329-341, api_fsm_channel 556-562, api_restore_call 600-610, api_start_goroutines 630-640, api_restore_body 723-755, raft_process_logs 1296-1314, raft_batch_flush 1336-1362), and the interface excerpt uses a fresh ID, store_commit_interface, spanning the whole CommitTrackingLogStore declaration at log.go 194-221. The harness is unchanged and locally verified: a real single-node prefix that commits 200 commands, snapshots at index 202 and commits a second batch, restarted against retained stores, returns in 1 ms with a 50-batch tail, returns in 3 ms at exactly 128 batches (8192 entries), and never returns within 20 s at 129 batches, with one goroutine parked in processLogs. The request declares the three case events as prerequisites with replay_batches conditions and asserts returned == true on each result event, and it validates against submission.schema.json.
